    while (!stack.empty()) {
        auto& top = stack.back();
        if (top.processed) {
            stack.pop_back();
            continue;
        }
        
        if (top.cur % degs[top.d] == 0) {
            top.result = top.cur / degs[top.d] * top.d;
            top.processed = true;
            continue;
        }
        
        ll k = top.cur / degs[top.d];
        stack.push_back({top.cur - k * degs[top.d], top.d - 1, false, 0});
        stack.push_back({(k + 1) * degs[top.d] - top.cur, top.d - 1, false, 0});

        ll option2 = (k + 1) * d + solve((k + 1) * degs[d] - cur, d - 1);
